entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?
It's not needed.
Okay, I understand. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the details?
Sarah Jenkins. Order 8-6-7-5-3-0-9.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 12th. I'm just noting here that today is January 26th, so you've had the device for 14 days.
Right. So, what's the return address?

Well, this is where it gets a bit specific. Because the VeloBand Pulse is a health device that activates and links to a user's account, it has a strict 10-day return policy for hygiene and data security reasons. Unfortunately, at 14 days, we are outside that window.
Of course you are. Just fantastic. I suppose I should have called from the hospital to make sure I met your precious deadline.
I understand your frustration, but the policy is... wait, did you say hospital? I apologize, I don't mean to pry, but was there an emergency that prevented you from contacting us sooner?
My husband had to have emergency surgery. He was supposed to take the band with him on his deployment, but that's obviously not happening now. So, yes, I was a little preoccupied.

Oh, Sarah, I am so incredibly sorry to hear that. Please, disregard what I just said about the policy. A medical emergency is absolutely a valid reason for an exception. My primary concern is that I hope your husband is recovering well.
He's fine. So can you process the return or not?

Yes, absolutely. I've already noted the exception on your account. I also see you're a VIP member with us, and we truly appreciate your loyalty. I have the authority to process this as a one-time courtesy. I can issue a full refund to your original method of payment right now. How does that sound?
Fine. Yes, that works.

Excellent. I have just processed that full refund. You should see it reflect in your account within 3-5 business days. I'm also emailing you a prepaid return label now. You can just drop the package off at any post office. Again, my apologies for the difficulty, and I sincerely hope things improve for you and your husband.
Okay. Thank you.

You're very welcome. And for the trouble, I've also added a 25% discount voucher to your VeloFit account for any future purchase, with no expiration date. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
